notes: 26 prior observations from two audits, plus two new research-gate defects.
Overlapping symptoms do not constitute 28 independent production vulnerabilities.
Fixing the research gate does not fix the staging simulator, RecoveryOS, or outstanding buyer proof.

items.summary: A direct update to simulated_cases.funds_json added $9,876,543.21 in candidate value even though only an INTAKE event existed. StagingTwin.verify() still returned PASS_SYNTHETIC_ONLY.
items.code_reference: unified/staging.py:278–310 only checks bounds among current balances, not the event-derived balance. Replay all events independently to reconstruct financial state and compare bytewise.

items.summary: Changed the stored invoice total to $9,999,999.99 without updating the source binding/evidence chain. Verification still passed.
items.code_reference: unified/staging.py:301 checks only source-customer ID equality. Recompute the canonical source hash and binding from immutable input, verify source version and immutable contract authority.

items.summary: Inserted a $1,000,000 simulated cash journal row linked to an INTAKE event. Verifier accepted the unbacked cash with no fee, credit or settlement event.
items.code_reference: unified/staging.py:303–308 validates positive amounts and distinct accounts, not allowed debit/credit accounts or transaction/event types. Enforce balanced, event-matched ledger postings and independently reconstructed cash.

items.summary: Benchmark-visible invoice objects contain expected_base_cents, expected_fuel_cents, and expected_accessorial_cents. A learner can simply subtract already-calculated correct amounts.
items.code_reference: unified/core.py:61–64 excludes four truth fields but leaves derived expected values. unified/customers.py:59–73 directly uses them. The older Lab 1's prediction_benchmark.PUBLIC_FIELDS intentionally withholds these. Restore strict raw-input/blind-truth separation and freeze the scoring population.

items.summary: With only a boolean scope_signed, the finance role successfully invoiced a 50% contingency fee because its rate is supplied at invoice time. No signed fee rate is present to compare it with.
items.code_reference: unified/staging.py:171–174,218–225. Freeze signed, versioned engagement terms before audit or claim and reject any unmatched fee rate.

items.summary: Revoking buyer authorization after a simulated credit/fee changes the state to REVIEW_REQUIRED; the system then refuses a financial reversal and its verification still passes.
items.code_reference: unified/staging.py:174–176,231–246. Separate prospect/claim authority from continuing accounting, refund and remediation obligations; preserve reversal paths after revocation.

items.summary: When a carrier settlement is $10 and the first credit is $4, a second valid modeled $6 credit is rejected as INVALID_TRANSITION:RECEIVED->CREDIT.
items.code_reference: unified/staging.py:204–216. Represent one-to-many credit/remittance events with unique references, open balances, partial reconciliation and multi-event fee adjustments.

items.summary: The 10,000-invoice sample has 4,250 distinct fictional source customers but only 72 display company names. This creates 4,178 account-to-name collisions.
items.code_reference: unified/customers.py:24–44. Use stable unique names/display disambiguation; keep signed identity keys separate from display names.

items.summary: Same frozen invoice processed in two distinct cases for the same tenant, both earn and collect a $2 fictional fee. The verifier passes and reports $4 simulated cash.
Two different synthetic tenants can create/read separate cases backed by the same source invoice without an independently attested source-owner entitlement. Local HTTP POSTs return 201 for both.
JSON scope_signed: "false" (a string) is truthy, so CONSENT produces CONSENTED; HTTP returns 200.
A NEGATIVE synthetic ground-truth invoice can move through candidate, human review, authorization, fake carrier settlement and fee collection. StagingTwin.verify() passes and counts fictional cash.
A $2 fee earned with only $0.40 collected can be closed without a write-off or outstanding-balance disposition. The verifier passes.
Reversing the entire $10 modeled credit after invoicing but before fee collection leaves $2 recorded as earned and receivable. The verifier passes.
Idempotency key replay by a *different* allowed actor returns IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY even though the event remains attributed to the original actor.
Same fictional provider reference used in two distinct tenants causes a raw sqlite3.IntegrityError rather than a typed rejection; the local HTTP handler catches Rejected but not that error.

Modified the COUNTERFACTUAL_MODELED financial event by $100,000 and recomputed the event/case hashes. The separate semantic verifier still passed because it never reconciles event amounts against the reported case totals.
A value of −1,000,000 ms in modeled latency passed independent verification after rehashing. It would corrupt performance statistics if used in a summary.
A fake https://attacker-controlled.invalid/... competitor evidence URL passed the independent verifier after rehashing. HTTPS alone is treated as sufficient.

In first 2,400 source samples, 334 potential savings estimates had implementation costs larger than gross benefit but reported zero net instead of a negative result. Total suppressed downside was 643,225 cents ($6,432.25) fictional.
Rehashed fraud_ground_truth=true for a non-risk case while retaining a REVIEW decision; independent verifier still passed due to conditional, one-sided flag checks.
Changed the source digest to 64 e characters and recalculated the case digest. Per-case oracle still passed; it does not receive the original frozen source row to compare.
Altered the BANK_RECONCILIATION event amount to 120,000,220 cents while the scenario summary reported 220 cents, recomputed all hashes; Lab 5 semantic oracle still passed.
A SETTLED_THEN_REVERSED case passed despite having no reversal event whatsoever: the engine silently replaces settled/received amounts with zero.
Seven fabricated rows with the same wrong source digest passed the "cross-lab" reconciliation. That SQL gate compares seven rows *to one another* and does not include source-owner identity.

Labs 11–14 installer returns RESTORED_VERIFIED_ARCHIVES when zero files were restored and a required archive was missing; it includes an archives_skipped list but still labels the operation successful.
items.code_reference: Fail closed on missing required archive. Distinguish toolkit-only partial restore as INCOMPLETE_OPTIONAL and require full-source checks before VERIFIED.

items.summary: CLI returned process exit 0 while the independent semantic result was FAIL
Over-rejecting validator passed negative-only tests after an incorrectly nested event-handler check
